fields.goal: string, non-empty — the ONE goal, held stable across steps
fields.parent_goal: string or null — optional. The goal THIS one serves, when you are on a sub-task. Lets an excursion be spelled instead of collapsed into the single goal slot.
fields.distance: integer 0-10 — how far from done (0 = done)
fields.blocked: string or null — what blocks you, or null

well_formed: a non-empty goal and a progress in progress_enum
use: Spell your state into this schema each step. Ungrammaticality, a stuck/circling self-report, a goal drifted from your first goal, or a stalled distance is your signal to return to ground. If the user redirected you, reset. If you are on a sub-task, name its parent_goal.
